$comment: 全站游戏元数据唯一真源。所有登记点（vite 入口 / more-games / index 卡片 / sitemap / manifest / Workers 白名单 / 校验器页面清单 / README）一律由 tools/generators/gen-from-registry.mjs 从本文件派生（npm run gen）。caps 是校验器与迁移脚本的唯一判据：sidebar=有 .game-sidebar；drawer=接移动端统计抽屉；frame-budget=桌面舞台纵向预算（verify-desktop-frame 检查）；leaderboard=使用共享排行榜 Worker；daily=有每日挑战（键 <scores.dailyKeyPrefix>-YYYYMMDD）；analytics=客户端调用 hubTrack。layout=页面布局类型（缺省 standard；immersive = 顶栏以下整块视口归场景，见 docs/contracts/layout.md §7），互斥类型用独立字段而不是 cap。

desc.zh: 踏剑穿越仙环与云海，斩开山岩，召出剑阵，一路破境飞升。

desc.meta: 折光 Lumen — an original beam refraction puzzle. Flip mirrors, bend the beam, light every crystal and keep shadow crystals dark. 25 levels in 5 chapters with decoy mirrors, linked mirrors and beam splitters, plus a daily puzzle for the whole world.

Keep the tiny door between two chambers: let fast molecules into the left, shove slow ones to the right, and a real temperature gap appears out of nothing. desc.twitter: Keep the door. Sort the molecules. Pay for every bit you learn.

desc.og: Find the sweet spot, pull in rhythm, and harvest the garden.
desc.twitter: Pull in rhythm, keep your streak, and harvest six giant carrots.
